blocks.text: if I do va if I did — real va xayoliy shart

Ikkala qolipni qizil kitobdan bilasiz: real shart — If it **rains**, we**'ll** stay at home (→ qizil kitob, 99-dars), xayoliy shart — If I **had** a car, I**'d** drive to work (→ qizil kitob, 100-dars). if-qismda will ishlatilmasligi 25-darsda ko'rildi (→ 25-dars). Bu darsning asosiy savoli — **qaysi birini tanlash**. Muhimi: ikkala qolip ham **hozirgi yoki kelasi** zamon haqida. Farq vaqtda emas, so'zlovchining **qarashida**: bu narsa haqiqatda bo'lishi mumkinmi yoki u shunchaki xayolmi.

rows: If I **find** a job here, I**'ll** stay.
If I **found** a job here, I**'d** stay.

items.text: If the weather **is** fine tomorrow, we**'ll go** to the mountains.
If I **lived** in the mountains, I**'d go** skiing every weekend.
items.translation: Tog'da **yashaganimda**, har dam olish kuni chang'i **uchardim**.

blocks.text: Bir xil vaziyat ikki xil aytilishi mumkin. Kompaniyangiz yopilishi haqida mish-mish yuribdi va bu haqiqatan xavf bo'lsa: What **will** you do if you **lose** your job? Hamma narsa joyida, siz shunchaki xayol surayotgan bo'lsangiz: What **would** you do if you **lost** your job? O'zbekchada ham shunga o'xshash farq bor: «ishdan **ayrilsang**, nima **qilasan**?» — «ishdan **ayrilsang**, nima **qilarding**?». Natija qismidagi «-asan» / «-arding» farqi inglizchadagi **will** / **would** ga mos keladi.

items.text: If Tom **calls**, tell him I'm at the gym — he said he might ring today.
items.translation: Tom **qo'ng'iroq qilsa**, sport zalida ekanimni ayt — bugun qo'ng'iroq qilishi mumkinligini aytgan edi.

items.text: If a famous film director **called** me, I**'d** probably think it was a joke.
items.translation: Mashhur kinorejissyor menga **qo'ng'iroq qilsa**, ehtimol buni hazil deb **o'ylardim**.

blocks.text: Xayoliy shartda fe'l **Past Simple** shaklida, lekin ma'no **o'tmish emas**: If I **had** more money (hozir yo'q), I **would** buy a flat (hozir yoki kelajakda). O'tgan zamon shakli bu yerda vaqtni emas, **haqiqatdan uzoqlikni** bildiradi: «bu — real emas». O'zbekchada ham shunday: «pulim **bo'lganida**» — o'tgan zamon qo'shimchasi bor, lekin gap hozir haqida. O'tmishdagi xayoliy holat uchun boshqa qolip bor: If I **had known** ... (→ 40-dars).

items.text: If we **had** a garden, the children **would** spend more time outside.
Bekzod **would** be a great teacher if he **was** a bit more patient.

blocks.text: will va would faqat **natija** qismida. if-qismda real shartda Present, xayoliy shartda Past ishlatiladi: «If I will see him» emas — If I **see** him; «If I would have time» emas — If I **had** time. Bitta istisno — xushmuomala iltimos: **If you would** wait here, the doctor will see you soon (= iltimos, shu yerda kutib turing). Bu rasmiy va kam uchraydigan uslub, oddiy shart emas.

if-qism gapning boshida ham, oxirida ham turishi mumkin; boshida bo'lsa, undan keyin vergul qo'yiladi: If it rains, we'll stay in. / We'll stay in if it rains. Real shartda natija qismida will dan tashqari **can**, **may**, **might**, **should** yoki buyruq gap kelishi mumkin; xayoliy shartda esa **would**, **could** («qila olardi») yoki **might** («balki ...ardi»).

items.text: You **can** use my laptop if yours **stops** working again.
If Madina **had** a driving licence, she **could** take the job in Fergana.
items.translation: Madinaning haydovchilik guvohnomasi **bo'lganida**, Farg'onadagi ishga **kira olardi**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «If I will have time, I will help you» → If I **have** time, I'll help you; «If I would know her number, I would call» → If I **knew** her number, I'd call; «If I had money» ni o'tmish deb tushunish («pulim bor edi») — aslida bu **hozir** pul yo'qligini bildiradi; real reja haqida xayoliy shaklni ishlatish: «If we went to Samarkand tomorrow, we'd visit the Registan» (agar sayohat rejalashtirilgan bo'lsa) → If we **go** ..., we**'ll** visit.

Tanlashning oson yo'li — o'zingizga savol bering: «Bu haqiqatan bo'lishi mumkinmi?» Ha → If + Present, will. Yo'q, bu faqat xayol yoki juda kam ehtimol → If + Past, would. O'zbekcha natija qismi ham yordam beradi: «**qilaman**» → will, «**qilardim**» → would.

examples.title: Real: **If** it **rains**, we**'ll** ...
examples.description: Real shart: if + Present Simple, natijada will (yoki buyruq, can). Bu narsa haqiqatda bo'lishi mumkin. O'zbekchada «-sa, ... -aman».

sentences.text: If it **rains** tomorrow, we**'ll have** the picnic at home instead.
sentences.translation: Ertaga yomg'ir **yog'sa**, piknikni uyda **o'tkazamiz**.

sentences.text: I**'ll lend** you my notes if you **miss** the lecture on Monday.
sentences.translation: Dushanbadagi ma'ruzani **o'tkazib yuborsangiz**, qaydlarimni **berib turaman**.

sentences.text: If the flight **leaves** on time, we**'ll land** in London at four.
sentences.translation: Reys o'z vaqtida **uchsa**, Londonga soat to'rtda **qo'namiz**.

sentences.text: Madina **will get** a discount if she **shows** her student card.
sentences.translation: Madina talabalik guvohnomasini **ko'rsatsa**, chegirma **oladi**.

sentences.text: You**'ll feel** much better if you **get** a good night's sleep.
sentences.translation: Yaxshilab **uxlab olsangiz**, o'zingizni ancha yaxshi **his qilasiz**.

sentences.text: If the shop **doesn't have** my size, I**'ll order** the jacket online.
sentences.translation: Do'konda mening o'lchamim **bo'lmasa**, kurtkani onlayn **buyurtma qilaman**.

sentences.text: The company **will lose** its best workers if it **doesn't raise** salaries soon.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya tez orada maoshlarni **oshirmasa**, eng yaxshi xodimlaridan **ayriladi**.

sentences.text: Don't wait for me if **I'm late** — just **start** without me.
sentences.translation: Agar **kechiksam**, meni kutmanglar — **boshlayveringlar**.

sentences.text: We **can** go for a walk along the river if the weather **is** nice.
sentences.translation: Havo yaxshi **bo'lsa**, daryo bo'yida sayr **qilishimiz mumkin**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **will be** furious if he **finds out** that we used his car without asking.
sentences.translation: Bekzod mashinasini so'ramasdan ishlatganimizni **bilib qolsa**, juda **g'azablanadi**.

examples.title: Unreal: **If** I **had** ..., I**'d** ...
examples.description: Xayoliy shart: if + Past Simple, natijada would. Shakli o'tmish, ma'nosi hozir: haqiqatda bunday emas. O'zbekchada «-ganimda, ... -ardim».

sentences.text: If I **had** more free time, I**'d learn** to play the dutar.
sentences.translation: Bo'sh vaqtim ko'proq **bo'lganida**, dutor chalishni **o'rganardim**.

sentences.text: Life **would be** much easier if we **lived** closer to the office.
sentences.translation: Ofisga yaqinroq **yashaganimizda**, hayot ancha **oson bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: If Aziz **spoke** better English, he**'d apply** for the job in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Aziz ingliz tilida yaxshiroq **gapirganida**, Manchesterdagi ishga **ariza topshirardi**.

sentences.text: I**'d buy** that flat tomorrow if it **wasn't** so far from the metro.
sentences.translation: Metrodan bunchalik uzoq **bo'lmaganida**, o'sha kvartirani ertagayoq **sotib olardim**.

sentences.text: Most people **wouldn't** use their cars so much if public transport **was** better.
sentences.translation: Jamoat transporti yaxshiroq **bo'lganida**, ko'pchilik mashinasidan bunchalik ko'p **foydalanmasdi**.

sentences.text: If my phone **didn't** have a camera, I **wouldn't take** so many photos of my food.
sentences.translation: Telefonimda kamera **bo'lmaganida**, ovqatimni bunchalik ko'p **suratga olmasdim**.

sentences.text: Sarah **would visit** her family more often if the flights **weren't** so expensive.
sentences.translation: Aviachiptalar bunchalik qimmat **bo'lmaganida**, Sara oilasini tez-tez **ko'rgani borardi**.

sentences.text: We **could** go to Edinburgh for the festival if we **had** enough holiday left.
sentences.translation: Ta'tilimiz yetarlicha **qolganida**, festivalga Edinburgga **borishimiz mumkin edi**.

sentences.text: Imagine you **were** the head of the school — what **would** you **change** first?
sentences.translation: Maktab direktori **bo'lganingizni** tasavvur qiling — birinchi navbatda nimani **o'zgartirardingiz**?

sentences.text: Kate **wouldn't** worry so much about money if she **had** a permanent job.
sentences.translation: Doimiy ishi **bo'lganida**, Keyt pul haqida bunchalik **xavotirlanmasdi**.

examples.title: Real or imagined? **If I find** / **If I found**
examples.description: Juft gaplar: avval real shart (bo'lishi mumkin), keyin xayoliy (bo'lmaydi yoki kam ehtimol). Tanlov — so'zlovchining qarashida.

sentences.text: If I **find** your sunglasses in the car, I**'ll bring** them tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Quyosh ko'zoynagingni mashinadan **topsam**, ertaga **olib kelaman**.

sentences.text: If I **found** a wallet full of money in the street, I**'d take** it to the police.
sentences.translation: Ko'chada pulga to'la hamyon **topib olsam**, uni politsiyaga **topshirardim**.

sentences.text: Our team **will reach** the final if we **beat** the team from Oxford tonight.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun Oksford jamoasini **yengsak**, jamoamiz finalga **chiqadi**.

sentences.text: Our team **would reach** the final if we **had** a better goalkeeper, but we don't.
sentences.translation: Yaxshiroq darvozabonimiz **bo'lganida**, jamoamiz finalga **chiqardi**, lekin afsuski, yo'q.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **will stay** in Tashkent if she **gets** a place at the university there.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza Toshkentdagi universitetga **kirsa**, o'sha yerda **qoladi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **would stay** in Tashkent if her parents **didn't** live in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Ota-onasi Farg'onada **yashamaganida**, Dilnoza Toshkentda **qolardi**.

sentences.text: What **will** happen if the company **closes** the factory? — Hundreds of people will lose their jobs.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya zavodni **yopsa**, nima **bo'ladi**? — Yuzlab odamlar ishsiz qoladi.

sentences.text: What **would** happen if everyone **stopped** using plastic tomorrow?
sentences.translation: Ertadan hamma plastikdan **foydalanmay qo'ysa**, nima **bo'lardi**?

sentences.text: Tell Oliver to **call** me if he **needs** help with the move.
sentences.translation: Oliverga ayt, ko'chishda yordam **kerak bo'lsa**, menga **qo'ng'iroq qilsin**.

sentences.text: Oliver **would** never **ask** for help, even if he **needed** it.
sentences.translation: Oliver yordam **kerak bo'lganida ham**, hech qachon **so'ramasdi**.

examples.title: Questions: What **will** / **would** you do **if** ...?
examples.description: Real savol — What will you do if + Present? Xayoliy savol — What would you do if + Past? Har xil so'roq so'zlari bilan.

sentences.text: What **will** you **do** if the bank **refuses** your loan? — I'll try another bank.
sentences.translation: Bank kredit berishni **rad etsa**, nima **qilasiz**? — Boshqa bankka urinib ko'raman.

sentences.text: What **would** you **do** if somebody **offered** you a job in New York?
sentences.translation: Kimdir sizga Nyu-Yorkdan ish **taklif qilsa**, nima **qilardingiz**?

sentences.text: Where **would** you **live** if you **could** choose any city in the world?
sentences.translation: Dunyodagi istalgan shaharni **tanlay olsangiz**, qayerda **yashardingiz**?

sentences.text: **Will** you **come** with us to Samarkand if we **go** by train on Friday?
sentences.translation: Juma kuni poyezdda **borsak**, biz bilan Samarqandga **borasizmi**?

sentences.text: **Would** you **move** abroad if your company **asked** you to?
sentences.translation: Kompaniyangiz **so'rasa**, chet elga **ko'chib ketarmidingiz**?

sentences.text: If you **lost** your passport abroad, who **would** you **contact** first?
sentences.translation: Chet elda pasportingizni **yo'qotib qo'ysangiz**, birinchi kimga **murojaat qilardingiz**?

sentences.text: If the train **is** cancelled, how **will** we **get** to the conference?
sentences.translation: Poyezd bekor **qilinsa**, konferensiyaga qanday **yetib boramiz**?

sentences.text: How **would** you **feel** if your best friend **forgot** your birthday?
sentences.translation: Eng yaqin do'stingiz tug'ilgan kuningizni **unutib qo'ysa**, o'zingizni qanday **his qilardingiz**?

sentences.text: Who **will look** after the cat if we both **go** away at the weekend?
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari ikkalamiz ham **ketib qolsak**, mushukka kim **qaraydi**?

sentences.text: Which language **would** you **learn** if you **had** a whole year free?
sentences.translation: Butun bir yil bo'sh **vaqtingiz bo'lganida**, qaysi tilni **o'rganardingiz**?

examples.title: Unlikely events: **If** I **won** ...
examples.description: Kam ehtimolli yoki g'alati holatlar haqida xayol: if + Past, would. Haqiqatda kutilmaydi — shuning uchun xayoliy shakl.

sentences.text: If I **won** a lot of money, I**'d set up** a charity for children in rural areas.
sentences.translation: Katta pul **yutib olsam**, qishloq joylardagi bolalar uchun xayriya jamg'armasi **ochardim**.

sentences.text: Tashkent **would look** magical if it **snowed** on New Year's Eve.
sentences.translation: Yangi yil kechasi qor **yog'sa**, Toshkent sehrli **ko'rinardi**.

sentences.text: If the internet **stopped** working for a week, many businesses **would** close.
sentences.translation: Internet bir hafta **ishlamay qolsa**, ko'plab korxonalar **yopilib qolardi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **would be** shocked if her shy brother **sang** at the wedding.
sentences.translation: Uyatchan ukasi to'yda **qo'shiq aytsa**, Nilufar **hayratda qolardi**.

sentences.text: If a famous actor **walked** into our office, nobody **would** do any work.
sentences.translation: Ofisimizga mashhur aktyor **kirib kelsa**, hech kim ish **qilmay qo'yardi**.

sentences.text: We**'d** probably **panic** if the lights **went** out during the exam.
sentences.translation: Imtihon paytida chiroq **o'chib qolsa**, ehtimol **vahimaga tushardik**.

sentences.text: Tom **would** never **forgive** himself if he **missed** his daughter's graduation.
sentences.translation: Qizining bitiruv marosimini **o'tkazib yuborsa**, Tom o'zini hech qachon **kechirmasdi**.

sentences.text: What a disaster it **would be** if the cake **fell** on the floor before the guests arrived!
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin tort yerga **tushib ketsa**, qanday falokat **bo'lardi**!

sentences.text: Suppose robots **did** all the housework — what **would** people **do** with their free time?
sentences.translation: Faraz qiling, uy ishlarining hammasini robotlar **qilsa** — odamlar bo'sh vaqtida nima **qilardi**?

sentences.text: My grandmother **would be** over the moon if we **visited** her every weekend.
sentences.translation: Har dam olish kuni **borib tursak**, buvim **juda xursand bo'lardi**.

examples.title: Other results: **could** and **might**
examples.description: Natija qismida would o'rniga: could — «qila olardi», might — «balki ...ardi» (xayoliy); real shartda can va might.

sentences.text: I **could** visit my parents in Bukhara more often if I **had** a car.
sentences.translation: Mashinam **bo'lganida**, Buxorodagi ota-onamni tez-tez **ko'rgani bora olardim**.

sentences.text: We **might** see the northern lights if we **go** to Scotland in winter.
sentences.translation: Qishda Shotlandiyaga **borsak**, shimol shu'lasini **ko'rishimiz mumkin**.

sentences.text: If you **practised** every day, you **could** pass the exam easily.
sentences.translation: Har kuni **mashq qilsangiz**, imtihondan bemalol **o'ta olardingiz**.

sentences.text: Kate **might** get the promotion if she **finishes** the project on time.
sentences.translation: Loyihani o'z vaqtida **tugatsa**, Keyt lavozimga **ko'tarilishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: We **could** invite more people for dinner if our kitchen **was** bigger.
sentences.translation: Oshxonamiz kattaroq **bo'lganida**, kechki ovqatga ko'proq odam **chaqira olardik**.

sentences.text: If the price **dropped** a little, more students **might** buy the new tablet.
sentences.translation: Narx biroz **tushsa**, balki ko'proq talabalar yangi planshetni **sotib olardi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **could** run a marathon if he **trained** regularly, but he's too lazy.
sentences.translation: Muntazam **mashq qilganida**, Jasur marafonda **yugura olardi**, lekin u juda dangasa.

sentences.text: You **might** feel less tired if you **drank** more water during the day.
sentences.translation: Kun davomida ko'proq suv **ichsangiz**, balki kamroq **charchardingiz**.

sentences.text: The children **could** play outside all day if it **wasn't** so hot.
sentences.translation: Havo bunchalik issiq **bo'lmaganida**, bolalar kun bo'yi tashqarida **o'ynay olardi**.

sentences.text: Who knows? If you **sent** your CV to that company, they **might** call you back.
sentences.translation: Kim biladi? O'sha kompaniyaga rezyumengizni **yuborsangiz**, sizga **qo'ng'iroq qilishlari mumkin**.

examples.title: Dialogue: a job offer in London
examples.description: Suhbat: Bekzod Londondan ish taklifi oldi — real va xayoliy shartlar bir suhbatda almashib keladi.

sentences.text: — Bekzod, what **would** you **do** if they **offered** you that job in London?
sentences.translation: — Bekzod, o'sha Londondagi ishni sizga **taklif qilishsa**, nima **qilardingiz**?

sentences.text: — Actually, they have. If I **accept**, I**'ll start** in September.
sentences.translation: — Aslida, taklif qilishdi. **Rozi bo'lsam**, sentyabrda **boshlayman**.

sentences.text: — Wow! And **will** your family **come** with you if you **go**?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Agar **ketsangiz**, oilangiz siz bilan **boradimi**?

sentences.text: — My wife **would come** if she **could**, but she's just started a new job here.
sentences.translation: — **Iloji bo'lganida**, xotinim **borardi**, lekin u bu yerda yangi ishni endi boshladi.

sentences.text: — That's difficult. I **wouldn't go** alone if I **were** you.
sentences.translation: — Bu qiyin. **Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam**, yolg'iz **ketmasdim**.

sentences.text: — Perhaps. But if I **say** no, I**'ll** probably **regret** it for years.
sentences.translation: — Balki. Lekin **rad etsam**, ehtimol yillar davomida **afsuslanaman**.

sentences.text: — What if you **asked** them to let you work from Tashkent part of the time?
sentences.translation: — Vaqtning bir qismida Toshkentdan ishlashga ruxsat **so'rasangiz-chi**?

sentences.text: — That's an idea! If they **agree**, I**'ll** only **need** to fly there once a month.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr! Agar **rozi bo'lishsa**, oyiga bir marta uchib borishim **kifoya qiladi**.

sentences.text: — And if they **said** no, you **could** still decide later, couldn't you?
sentences.translation: — Rad **etishsa** ham, keyinroq hal **qila olardingiz**, shunday emasmi?

sentences.text: — True. I**'ll call** them tomorrow if I **feel** brave enough!
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri. Yetarlicha **jur'atim bo'lsa**, ertaga ularga **qo'ng'iroq qilaman**!

examples.title: Mixed: real chances and pure imagination
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: real va xayoliy shart, if-qism gapning boshida va oxirida.

sentences.text: If the weather **is** good on Sunday, we**'ll drive** to the Charvak reservoir.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni havo yaxshi **bo'lsa**, Chorvoq suv omboriga mashinada **boramiz**.

sentences.text: I**'d** never **leave** this village if the weather **was** always this good.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo doim shunday yaxshi **bo'lganida**, bu qishloqdan hech qachon **ketmasdim**.

sentences.text: Your manager **will understand** if you **explain** the situation honestly.
sentences.translation: Vaziyatni halol **tushuntirsangiz**, menejeringiz **tushunadi**.

sentences.text: People **would trust** politicians more if they **kept** their promises.
sentences.translation: Siyosatchilar va'dalarini **bajarganida**, odamlar ularga ko'proq **ishonardi**.

sentences.text: If you **see** Emma at the conference, **give** her my regards.
sentences.translation: Konferensiyada Emmani **ko'rsangiz**, unga mendan **salom ayting**.

sentences.text: Suppose you **found** out your colleague was stealing — **would** you **tell** the boss?
sentences.translation: Faraz qiling, hamkasbingiz o'g'irlik qilayotganini **bilib qoldingiz** — boshliqqa **aytarmidingiz**?

sentences.text: Prices **will go** up again if the government **doesn't** control inflation.
sentences.translation: Hukumat inflyatsiyani **nazorat qilmasa**, narxlar yana **oshadi**.

sentences.text: The kids **would** spend all day online if we **didn't** set any limits.
sentences.translation: Hech qanday **cheklov qo'ymasak**, bolalar kun bo'yi internetda **o'tirardi**.

sentences.text: If I **had** Oliver's confidence, I**'d start** my own business tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Menda Oliverning ishonchi **bo'lganida**, ertagayoq o'z biznesimni **boshlardim**.

sentences.text: **Call** me immediately if anything **goes** wrong with the boiler while we're away.
sentences.translation: Biz yo'qligimizda isitish qozonida biror nosozlik **chiqsa**, darhol menga **qo'ng'iroq qiling**.
